title: Qualify owner-gated scientific adoption and close W02 documentation
commitMessage: docs: qualify M6 scientific adoption boundaries and close W02

contribution.summary: Complete C05-T2 documentary Q/O/D, C05 and scientific W02 using pinned seven-family evidence, owner-gated semver/notices and an explicit retain-and-defer disposition. Preserve no automatic external cutover, no Decision approval and no new product science; leave M6's separate G-M6 release gate open.
contribution.value: Record independent T2 decision/notices SHA-256 and the immutable RS102 local preview.14 receipt. Keep all seven families in Math, require per-family owner action, rights/licensing notices, semver, target-runtime verification and source-free consumer tests before any future change. Close C05 and W02 only after accepted documentary boundaries; no public release or sibling modification.
debtChanges: Require specific owner disposition before changing, replacing or removing any scientific family; unanswered proposals default to retain.
Any provider cutover requires immutable source/version/SHA, notices/rights, semver compatibility, target runtime and isolated consumer evidence.
Preserve RS102 preview.14 science as historical qualification only; RS104 is documentary, with no new scientific tests or pack.
Keep the Decision bracketed-root candidate as unsent owner review; no duplication, external acceptance or sibling change is asserted.
C05/W02 documentary completion does not satisfy the independent G-M6 release gate or authorize stable/public NuGet publishing.
Retain seven finite-domain/refusal contracts and prohibit automatic external migration or numeric error-certification claims.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS104 success, review the separate G-M6 release gate, independently verify all required M6 chunks and local package/consumer and rights evidence, and decide readiness versus explicit blockers before preparing a milestone-close run. Do not assume stable/public 1.1.0 publication or owner approval.
